prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square seamless albedo source texture for a low-poly fantasy game terrain material
Primary request: Create a seamless, repeatable dark moor peat and heather ground albedo texture for Grey Moors.
Style/medium: subdued painterly low-poly fantasy ground, matching the medium-scale mottling and restrained detail density of Eloria's approved stylized grass and desert materials; diffuse albedo only.
Composition/framing: perfectly flat orthographic view filling a square image; tile must repeat invisibly across both horizontal and vertical edges; even feature distribution, no focal center.
Color palette: dark warm peat brown mixed with muted olive and charcoal-brown, restrained heather tones.
Materials/textures: compressed damp peat with subtle broad low-contrast mottling, small embedded mineral flecks and compact lichen/heather color patches; patterns remain legible at a 4 metre terrain tile and from gameplay camera distance. Heather is texture coloration only, no standalone plants.
Lighting/mood: uniform neutral diffuse illumination with no directional variation.
Constraints: seamless across all four edges; flat albedo; no height, normal, roughness or metallic shading data; keep detail medium-scale and quiet.
Avoid: non-seamless edges, gradients, lighting, shadows, highlights, perspective, horizons, distinct props, plants, flowers, large stones, oversized speckles, high-frequency noise, cracks, tracks, text, logos, borders, watermark.
